title: America (My Country Tis Of Thee)
lyrics_synced:
[00:00.00] Keyboard: Brent Baileywww.wizard.net/~dsr
[00:02.43] .
[00:11.65] My country 'tis of thee,
[00:15.32] Sweet land of liberty,
[00:18.99] Of thee I sing;
[00:22.65] Land where my fathers died,
[00:26.38] Land of the Pilgrim's pride,
[00:29.95] From ev'ry mountainside,
[00:33.65] Let freedom ring.
[00:39.18] My native country, thee,
[00:42.89] Land of the noble free,
[00:46.58] Thy name I love;
[00:50.24] I love thy rocks and rills,
[00:53.90] Thy woods and templed hills,
[00:57.51] My heart with rapture thrills,
[01:01.18] Like that above.
[01:06.76] Let music sell the breeze,
[01:10.39] And ring from all the trees,
[01:14.13] Sweet freedom's song;
[01:17.75] Let mortal tongues awake,
[01:21.43] Let all that breathe partake;
[01:25.12] Let rocks their silence break,
[01:28.77] The sound prolong.
[01:34.29] Our father's God to Thee,
[01:37.98] Author of liberty,
[01:41.64] To Thee we sing;
[01:45.34] Long may our land be bright,
[01:49.02] With freedom's holy light,
[01:52.64] Protect us by Thy might,
[01:56.36] Great God, our King.
